card.name: Partway through varied medical words
card.fires_on: Responds to the start or middle of longer words such as 'Admin' before 'ister', 'yster' in hydroxysteroid, and 'retrospect' before 'ively'. Seen in drug-label text.

modes.label: Admin before ister
modes.description: The word 'Admin' starting an instruction sentence after a list of interacting drugs.
modes.example: inidine, fluoxetine, paroxetine) or CYP3A4 inhibitors (e.g., itraconazole, clarithromycin)<< Admin>>ister half of usual dose Strong CYP

modes.label: Inside long enzyme or adverb words
modes.description: A middle piece of a long word such as hydroxysteroid or retrospectively.
modes.example: ysteroid Dehydrogenase Type 1 (11βHSD-1) The microsomal enzyme 11β-hydrox<<yster>>oid dehydrogenase type 1

modes.label: Single words before a continuing phrase
modes.description: Ordinary words like 'thoroughly', 'visual' or 'result' inside a clause.
modes.example: mucosa<< thoroughly>> with water. Visually inspect parenteral
